steps.content: The shadows in the chaos disappear. The horrifying echoes fade as the fearsome creatures scatter, vanishing into the wilderness.
Not because someone has defeated them, but because the only prey has finally been completely devoured, and the remnants can no longer sustain the attention of Mania.
The empty shell of her remains in a gazing position, but can no longer see, hear, or feel anything.
The tears have dried up, and she can no longer move a step forward. Finally, Hestia kneels under the Illusory Moon, letting the red light permeate her hollow eyes and body.
The night is so heavy and vast, requiring no effort to crush the brave scholars or the young timid soul.

steps.speaker: Shattered Voice
steps.content: It's okay now... We've found you. You're not alone anymore...

steps.speaker: Shattered Voice
steps.content: We will survive. Not just here, but when all of this is over, we'll go out into the bigger world, and everyone will live happily together...

steps.speaker: Shattered Voice
steps.content: Welcome to the expedition, Hestia. If you want... would you like to become a guide too?
Memories flash through her mind and then shatter, weathering and fading quickly.

The girl raises her hands slowly. In Stor Town, she was trained countless times to raise the holy fire against disasters. In the expedition, she held up the torch many times at the camp, hoping her loved ones would soon return safely.

steps.speaker: Shattered Voice
steps.content: This fire is your power...

steps.speaker: Shattered Voice
steps.content: Your torch... lights up the way home for everyone...
But the torch by her side through the years has also turned to ash. Her hands are now empty.

After Nightfall, humanity has lost the world. Only fear spares the insignificant humans a possibility of life, teaching them reverence, guiding them to flee. God favors Hestia, and fear is the wisdom and gift bestowed upon her.
And this is the consequence of abandoning it.
Because she's realized even that brave little punk fears something, she dreams of having courage. And this is the outcome.
Darkness crawls up her tattered body and swallows her consciousness, returning everything to silence. The end is right here... At that moment, she laughs dryly.

The dregs of her courage, or despair, turn into overwhelming madness. When death finally comes, proving the long struggle meaningless, Hestia experiences liberation from fear for the first time. Love and friendship didn't save her, but destruction does.
Finally free, she reaches out to the brightness she can no longer see.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: The torch... is still here...

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: I'll light it...
The final spark falls into her palm, burning down her arm like a sprout growing from the roots, blooming. The broken, empty shell quickly <color=#dg1f1f>burns out and vanishes</color>.
Then it transforms into a <color=#dg1f1f>torch</color>, disappearing in an instant.
[Fade out]

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: ${PlayerName}, you know... Before today, I never liked you.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: The first day I was brought back to the camp, I saw you, another kid coddled by the crew. It made me so jealous and reminded me of fighting over a piece of bread with other kids when I was little. Or maybe I just didn't like losing.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: Later, I competed for the guide's position with you. To convince everyone, I made up so many nice tales, but they laughed it off each time. The routes you suggested were always bold and dangerous, yet everyone followed without protest.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: The things I'd never dared to face in my life, you never averted your gaze from. You pointed out the path directly, leading the team forward without looking back.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: You're even younger than me. Why weren't you ever afraid?

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: I couldn't do it. I could only follow behind you, trying to catch up while sulking.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: Looking back now... I wish I'd talked to you sooner.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: Then I would have known that courage alone isn't enough. Like today, watching you fall worried me so much.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: ...Don't you ever do this again.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: Press ahead bravely, but stay fearful at heart. Don't forget the dangers even if the goal is in sight. From now on, you are the only guide.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: Just like I need you, you need me too.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: I'll help you once more, for the last time. Consider it... <color=#fb9259>a thank you, for giving me courage</color>.
[Open eyes special effect]
You wake up.
Opening your eyes, you find yourself lying on the shallows of the DisSea. Tiny sparks hover in front of you, emitting comforting light and warmth quietly.
No answer. The little sparks draw a few circles, then drift in a certain direction. In a daze, you get up to follow them.

The red moon in the sky is glaring, yet now all you can see is the tiny dim light in front of you, the faint warmth makes you forget the long, intrusive darkness... Somehow, you feel you're no longer alone.
Yes, you're no longer alone... Continuing walking, you hear sounds. The wind, footsteps, and finally the vague, gentle whispers around you.
Where the sparks shine, some people come to your side before you notice.

steps.speaker: Blurry Figure
steps.content: Oh... What a fruitful journey. The calculations are correct and the theory has been proven. We've finally located the Perishing Star and established a base...

steps.speaker: Blurry Figure
steps.content: Who'd have thought? We've just taken the first step after all these years, and it's led us straight to our goal... Let's go back and celebrate. Celebrate the truth that's right before us. Uh, no...

steps.speaker: Blurry Figure
steps.content: First, let's celebrate that we've all come back alive and managed to find the way back...

One after another figure emerges, joining this returning crew. Someone takes your hand habitually, and another person pats your shoulder. You want to see their faces clearly, but your vision is wet and blurry while your heart is filled with a strange yet familiar warmth.
The Illusory Moon fades. The dreadful darkness is behind you. People move in the same direction, gradually forming a returning path.
The sparks along the path grow bright and dazzling, clarifying your mind.

steps.speaker: Blurry Figure
steps.content: I followed the spark here... Thank you, little guide... I'm glad you're here to show us the way...
You look around but don't find the person you're looking for.
The specters of the crowd pull you forward. You can feel the stele waiting for you ahead.
But somehow it feels like you've missed something.
No answer. She's not in the crowd, not ahead on the road, not at the stele.
You turn around. The flames you've passed along the way all feel strangely familiar. You want to go back to confirm it, but...
Someone rushes up to you from behind, embracing you.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: Pfft... Haha...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Hestia?
The girl blinks, not answering. But her eyes sparkle and her body gradually fades into the light.
And the light that belonged to the torch is now held up high in her hands, burning silently in the air.
In the blink of an eye, the joy of reunion turns to ice.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: No...

You turn back, searching for those burning flames. Perhaps you can find the residue. Perhaps you can still deny that dreadful guess. You don't care if it means staying here forever. You want to go back. You must go back.
But the guide won't allow it.
Hestia pulls your arm, dragging you back to the original path, giggling as if mocking you for straying. Her pace hastens, and you simply cannot resist the pull of the frail body.
In the end, the two of you are running. The sparks fall to the ground, blooming into a field of flowers. The specters following you along the way gradually stop, waving at you as if it's a farewell.
The path is bright, warm, yet short, quickly coming to an end. Waiting for you there is the nameless stele, the exit of the dream.
And your last companion lets go of your hand.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Hestia!
Hestia doesn't leave you. Even as the light erases her silhouette, she's still jogging after you, smiling and waving at you until she disappears. She says something.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>Don't worry...</color>
